title: BC Friday Tips #61 Check AppSource App Update History
summary: When evaluating AppSource apps for Business Central, check the last updated date before installing. Apps without recent updates risk containing bugs or failing to use current AL features since the platform changes with each release.
key_points: Check when an AppSource app was last updated before installing it
Treat an app that has gone a long time without updates as a risk
Business Central changes with every release, so stale apps may contain bugs
Apps that are not maintained may also miss newer AL features
